text:
sara_pm: Heads-up — we saw a tenant hit a sustained spike of 4k embeddings/sec and the ingest queue pressure climbed. Not a full outage but customers saw 413s and slow tails.

jordan_eng: Oof. Any pattern on dims or payload size?

sara_pm: Mostly variable dims (512 and 1536 mixed) in same batch, some huge arrays in a single POST. They use our batch endpoint with up to 2k items.

jordan_eng: That matches the splitter hitting OOM/backpressure. We throttle at the router if combined byte size > 6MB but mixed dims complicates batching.

micah_sre: From infra traces: memory spike on embed-worker-3, kernel retries, then fallback route kicked in. We saw X-Redwood-Backpressure header propagated but client doesn't surface it.

kiran_data: Telemetry note — per-route p95 token latency spiked, but console only shows overall p95. We need per-tenant per-route bytes-in-flight and throttled_count.

ellie_console: Agree. Proposal: add a "Traffic Insights" panel on the embed route page with metrics: bytes_in_flight, active_batches, throttled_reqs, backpressure_rate, avg_batch_size. Also a small explainer for mixed-dims behavior.

jordan_eng: We should also emit a reason code for fast-fail vs soft-throttle in the response body so SDKs can surface UX: e.g., {"error":"over_budget","reason":"bytes_in_flight"}.

sara_pm: +1. Product wants explicit SDK signal rather than opaque 413. Can we add header + JSON body without breaking existing clients?

micah_sre: Header only is safe for client libraries that read it. Changing body shape is risky; we can add optional "x-redwood-err-code" header and leave body unchanged. SDKs can opt-in to read header.

jordan_eng: Implementation plan: router detects batch plan size preflight, emits x-redwood-backpressure: soft or hard, and x-redwood-err-code when fast-fail. Also log the preflight snapshot to trace: batch_item_count, total_bytes, max_dim, shard_candidates.

kiran_data: For telemetry pipeline, add a rollup metric 'embed.ingest.backpressure_rate' tagged by tenant_id, route, and quota_tier. Also export a histogram of batch_bytes to console.

ellie_console: UX questions: where to show per-tenant throttles without leaking data? We'll only show to self-managed tenant accounts (admins) and to internal support with obfuscated ids.

sara_pm: Rollout plan: feature-flag header + metrics for 2 weeks in canary, expose console panel to internal only, then expand. Add docs for SDKs with sample snippet.

jordan_eng: Sample preflight curl for SDK doc:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings:batch \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "X-Redwood-Preflight: 1" \
  -d '{"inputs":["..."],"max_dim":1536}'
```

micah_sre: We'll add an alert: pager if backpressure_rate > 0.15 for > 5m on prod. Ops runbook: scale pool, enable aggressive splitter, or contact tenant to reduce batch concurrency.

ellie_console: I'll wire up a mock panel for the canary dashboard tomorrow. Need metric names and sample tags.

kiran_data: I'll update telemetry proto and add example queries.

sara_pm: Thanks. Action items: @jordan_eng add headers + preflight logs PR; @kiran_data telemetry proto PR; @ellie_console dashboard mock; @micah_sre alert and runbook. We'll check in 48hrs. :thumbsup:
